faqs.question: What is WhatsApp Business API in the United States?
faqs.answer:
• WhatsApp Business API, also known as the WhatsApp Business Platform, helps growing businesses in the United States communicate with customers without managing every conversation manually. It supports automated notifications, AI chatbots, CRM integrations, and customer support with multiple agents.
  • Businesses across New York, California, Texas, and the US can use it for order confirmations, shipping updates, authentication messages, appointment reminders, and customer enquiries.
  • With MSG91, businesses can automate WhatsApp conversations, connect messaging workflows to existing applications, and manage customer support through Hello, all from one platform.

faqs.question: Why should US businesses choose MSG91 as their WhatsApp Business API provider?
faqs.answer:
• Managing customer communication shouldn't mean switching between multiple platforms. MSG91 brings WhatsApp automation, AI chatbots, business notifications, and customer support together in one place.
  • US businesses can automate repetitive conversations, manage customer enquiries, and create communication workflows without building everything from scratch.
  • And MSG91 goes beyond WhatsApp. With MSG91 One API, businesses can connect SMS, RCS, email, WhatsApp, and voice through unified communication workflows, including fallback when messages fail.
  • You also get MSG91 Hello, an AI-powered customer support platform with a shared inbox where teams can manage conversations together.

faqs.question: What is the pricing of WhatsApp Business API in the United States?
faqs.answer:
• WhatsApp Business API pricing in the United States includes messaging charges and a platform subscription. MSG91 offers utility, authentication, and service messaging rates approximately 10% lower than Meta's standard USD pricing, helping businesses reduce communication costs.
  • MSG91's rates for US numbers (+1), in USD, are:
    • Marketing: $0.02256 per message*
    • Utility: $0.00307 per message
    • Authentication: $0.00307 per message
    • Service: $0.00307 per billable message after the free allowance
  • The MSG91 Titan plan costs $7/month, with the first two months free. Messaging charges and applicable taxes are separate.
  • For example, sending 10,000 billable utility messages costs $30.70 with MSG91 compared with $34 at Meta's standard rate, saving $3.30 before subscription fees and taxes.
  • Actual savings depend on messaging volume, applicable pricing tiers, and billing arrangements.
  • Meta currently restricts WhatsApp marketing template delivery to US recipients, even though a marketing rate appears in the rate card.
  • For a detailed breakdown, explore MSG91 WhatsApp Business API Pricing in the United States and Meta's WhatsApp Business Platform Pricing.

faqs.question: Can US businesses send WhatsApp marketing campaigns and generate leads through Click-to-WhatsApp Ads?
faqs.answer:
• Meta currently restricts WhatsApp marketing template messages sent to recipients with US phone numbers. This restriction began on April 1, 2025, and applies to all WhatsApp Business API providers.
  • But businesses can still use WhatsApp for eligible order updates, authentication messages, customer-initiated conversations, and Click-to-WhatsApp Ads.
  • For example, a US retailer can use Facebook or Instagram ads to encourage interested customers to start a WhatsApp conversation, where a chatbot can answer questions and guide them towards a product.
  • For promotional outreach, MSG91 Campaign lets businesses build supported SMS, RCS, email, and other communication workflows, subject to applicable channel rules and customer consent.
  • US businesses must also follow relevant messaging regulations, including applicable TCPA requirements and Meta's policies.
  • Explore MSG91 Campaign and the Click-to-WhatsApp Ads guide.

faqs.question: Can MSG91 AI WhatsApp chatbots automate customer enquiries and e-commerce support in the US?
faqs.answer:
• Yes. MSG91 AI WhatsApp chatbots can handle everything from simple questions to complex customer enquiries, 24/7.
  • What makes them powerful? You can combine rule-based steps and AI-powered conversations within a single chatbot, without building separate bots.
  • The chatbot can connect with 2,000+ apps, make API calls, and access information from connected business systems to manage order tracking, returns, product recommendations, and customer requests.
  • Businesses can also choose from multiple AI models and configure backup models, helping conversations continue if the primary model becomes unavailable.
  • For example, a California online store can use one chatbot to collect order details, check delivery status through APIs, recommend products using AI, and assist with returns.
  • When human assistance is needed, conversations move to agents through MSG91 Hello, where teams manage chats from a shared inbox or mobile app.
  • Explore MSG91 WhatsApp AI Chatbots, the Shopify integration guide, and the Hello mobile app.

faqs.question: How can US businesses reduce WhatsApp customer support costs after Meta's October 2026 pricing changes?
faqs.answer:
• Since October 1, 2026, Meta has charged for WhatsApp service messages beyond its monthly free allowance. The first 1,000 service messages per business phone number remain free each month, while additional messages are chargeable.
  • Utility templates sent within an active customer service window also became chargeable, subject to applicable exceptions.
  • For US businesses handling hundreds of customer enquiries daily, these additional costs can add up.
  • MSG91 Chat Window offers a simpler way to continue conversations: WhatsApp → Chat Window → Hello.
  • Customers begin on WhatsApp and move to a dedicated Chat Window through a link. AI chatbots and human agents can then continue assisting them through Hello without sending every reply through WhatsApp.
  • Messages exchanged inside Chat Window don't incur Meta's WhatsApp messaging charges. Messages actually sent through WhatsApp remain chargeable.
  • Follow the MSG91 Chat Window setup guide to learn more.

faqs.question: Can businesses send WhatsApp OTPs to customers in the US using MSG91?
faqs.answer:
• Yes. MSG91 allows US businesses to send WhatsApp OTPs for account verification, logins, and other eligible authentication workflows.
  • For example, a fintech application can use WhatsApp authentication to help customers verify their identity when signing in or completing supported account activities.
  • But what happens when a customer doesn't receive an OTP?
  • The MSG91 OTP Widget supports configurable verification and retry options across WhatsApp, SMS, voice, and email, depending on the selected setup.
  • This gives customers another way to receive verification codes without repeatedly restarting the login process.
  • Businesses can configure supported OTP workflows or integrate them using MSG91 APIs. Channel-specific charges and eligibility requirements apply.
  • Explore MSG91 OTP and the OTP Widget integration guide.

faqs.question: Which industries in the United States benefit most from WhatsApp Business API?
faqs.answer:
• Businesses that manage frequent customer enquiries, transactions, appointments, and service requests can benefit from WhatsApp Business API automation, especially when they serve customers who actively use WhatsApp.
  • Some relevant US industries include:
    • E-commerce and Retail: Send order confirmations, shipping notifications, return updates, and customer support replies.
    • SaaS and Technology: Automate account verification, onboarding notifications, and technical support enquiries.
    • Financial Services and Fintech: Send OTPs, transaction notifications, and account-related updates.
    • Healthcare and Private Clinics: Manage appointment reminders, scheduling enquiries, and administrative support, subject to applicable privacy requirements.
    • Real Estate: Answer property enquiries, qualify leads, and schedule viewings through customer-initiated conversations.
    • Travel and Hospitality: Handle reservations, check-in information, and guest assistance.
    • Logistics and Delivery: Share shipment tracking, delivery confirmations, and service updates.
  • With MSG91, businesses can connect WhatsApp to their existing systems through supported integrations or custom APIs.
  • AI chatbots handle repetitive enquiries while human agents focus on conversations that need personal attention.
  • Explore MSG91 Hello to manage customer communication from one place.

faqs.question: How can US businesses set up WhatsApp Business API and get support from MSG91?
